appExtDescription.message: MV3 cookie auto-delete: whitelist domains, clean the rest — open source.

tagline.message: Whitelist by domain, clean everything else on tab close.

protectLoginsTitle.message: Never auto-delete cookies that look like login/session cookies, unless you set an explicit clean-immediately rule.

clearSiteDataTitle.message: When cleaning a site's cookies, also clear its localStorage, IndexedDB and cache. Requests an extra browser permission when enabled.

emptyRulesTrust.message: No rules yet. Trust the current site above, or add a domain below — everything else follows the “$1” default.

emptyRulesAdd.message: No rules yet. Add a domain below — everything else follows the “$1” default.

emptyAudit.message: No cleanup events yet. Guardian works silently — events appear here once cookies are cleaned or observed.

clearAllMessage.message: This immediately deletes every cookie on every site, including trusted sites and logins — you'll be signed out everywhere. This cannot be undone.

obLede.message: Close a tab, and the cookies that site left behind are gone within seconds — except the sites you choose to trust. Here's the 30-second version.

obDoes1.message: Deletes cookies for a site moments after you close its last tab.

obDoes2.message: Runs a safety sweep every 30 seconds so nothing slips through.

obDoes3.message: Keeps a visible activity log — you can see exactly what got cleaned, and when.

obNever1.message: Never reads or changes the contents of web pages.

obNever2.message: Never uploads your cookies, rules, or activity anywhere.

obNever3.message: No analytics, no telemetry, no third-party scripts.

obNever4.message: Never logs you out of a site you're actively using.

obPickHeading.message: Pick how Guardian treats sites you haven't listed

obPickLede.message: You can change this any time from the popup. Trusted sites always stay logged in.

obChoiceCleanSub.message: Recommended. Auto-delete cookies for unlisted sites once you're done with them.

obChoiceSafeSub.message: Only delete cookies for sites you explicitly add a cleanup rule for.

obTrustOpenRest.message: Every line is on GitHub under the MIT license — read it, build it, and verify the published extension matches the source.

obTrustSaleRest.message: We've made a public, binding pledge never to sell the extension or your data. If we break it, you can fork us.

obTrustVerifyRest.message: We don't obfuscate our code, and we publish a guide for checking the build yourself.

obFooter.message: Pin Guardian to your toolbar to open the popup any time — add rules, trust the current site in one click, and watch the activity log.

optHeroDesc.message: MV3-native cookie auto-delete. Close a tab and the cookies that site left behind are gone within seconds — except the sites you trust. Everything runs on your device.

optPillar1Rest.message: MIT-licensed; read the code, rebuild it, and confirm the published extension matches the source.

optPillar2Rest.message: The popup's activity log records exactly which cookies were cleaned and when — automatic never means a black box.

optPillar3Rest.message: A public, binding pledge never to sell the extension or your data. If we break it, fork us.

optVerifyDesc.message: We don't obfuscate our code. You can read the shipped JavaScript, rebuild from source and compare, or scan the package with VirusTotal. The guide walks through each option.

optSettingsPre.message: Cleanup rules, the default action, and login protection live in the extension popup — click the

optSettingsPost.message: icon in your browser's toolbar to open it. This page is for trust & verification information.

cleanupDegraded.message: Cleanup is degraded — the last sweep failed. Protection may be incomplete.

obProtectedLede.message: Guardian is watching quietly in the background. Everything stays on your device — no account needed to start.

obDonePin.message: Pin the extension to your toolbar so it's always one click away.
